directives: Limit each ticker to one post per day; merge duplicate earnings or bubble-risk alerts into a single roundup post.
Add at least one index or macro post per day to balance the stock-heavy mix; commodities need a detailed analysis, not just a ticker mention.
Never draw support or resistance from fewer than 3 touches; if only 1-2 touches exist, label the level as 'provisional' or omit it.
Drop the boilerplate '🫧 Bubble risk' line from every caption; only include it when the post's category is not already bubble_risk.
Space analytical posts at least 30 minutes apart; never publish more than 2 posts within a 10-minute window.
